title: XPath injection into an unquoted predicate (error-based)
remediation: Never build an XPath expression from raw input; use a precompiled query with variable binding (e.g. XPathVariableResolver) so input is a value, not structure. A distinctive XPath engine error (XPathException / 'Expression must evaluate to a node-set') provoked by the malformed predicate but ABSENT from the benign control confirms injectability.
